_comment: BACK-COMPAT ROW for the 2026-08-16 default flip (USER directive: 'I want all of these features including debug'). That flip made debug.enable=true, peripherals.nfc=true and package.model=castalia-lqfp100 the SHIPPED DEFAULTS -- each in BOTH of its two literals (the _CONFIG_META schema default and the _cfg call site; check_config_defaults.py gates the pair). By the same back door castalia4.json exists to close, that would have removed the pre-flip shape from the matrix entirely: no config anywhere would have set debug.enable=false, so the D-series' whole INERTNESS CLAIM -- that a knob-OFF build emits NO trace of the Debug Module (no dmi_* ports, no dm0, no dtm0, no tck/tms/tdi/tdo/trstn, no clamp row, check_mcu_vhd.py STRICT the bar) -- would have become unprovable without adding a file. This is that file. It is now the ONLY configuration in the tree that exercises the debug-OFF emission arm AND the nfc-OFF arm (85-entry vector list, 3 glitch filters, no page-2 sub-slot 2 @0x6200, no MmrAddrNFC0). package is NAMED rather than inherited for the same reason the knobs are (the CLAUDE.md inheritance-trap discipline): castalia-quad-qfn64 was the default package before the flip, and it is also the model that CANNOT bond the TAP -- so this row doubles as the standing negative control for _checkDebugTransportBonded, which must stay silent here and FATAL the moment debug.enable is turned on against this package. Prove it with: SUITE=full make verify CONFIG=config/castalia_nodbgnfc.json
